text: 别说40了。
en: Let alone 40.

text: 男性和女性没有优渥的生活环境，没有精心的保养。
en: Men and women who lack a comfortable living environment and careful upkeep.

text: 22大学毕业的时候风华正茂，工作几年到26岁的时候都可以明显发觉变老了。
en: At 22, fresh out of university, one is in the full bloom of youth; after a few years of work, by 26 one can already noticeably perceive the ageing.

text: 只陈述事实，因为最近遇到了几个朋友，现在真的和四年前没法比了。
en: I am merely stating facts, because I have met a few friends recently, and things now really cannot compare with four years ago.

text: 考虑，40岁足够好看的话还是会考虑，
en: Consideration: if a 40-year-old is good-looking enough, I would still consider it,

text: 看脸。
en: It comes down to looks.

text: 目前相亲过两回，
en: So far I have been on blind dates twice,

text: 打那以后就发誓再也不去相亲了。
en: and since then I swore I would never go on a blind date again.

text: 两个相亲对象都跟我差不多大，看过照片后都是激动到不行。
en: Both blind date partners were about my age, and after seeing their photos I was thrilled beyond belief.

text: 尤其是第二个相亲对象好看到觉得自己不配，这么好看的女生，居然会跟我相亲！
en: Especially the second blind date partner, who was so beautiful that I felt I did not deserve her—such a pretty girl, and she was actually going on a blind date with me!

text: 于是我开了200多公里的车火急火燎的跑去相亲。
en: So I drove over 200 kilometres in a frantic rush to the blind date.

text: 这辈子就她了！
en: She would be the one for the rest of my life!

text: 去相亲的路上心里这样想着。
en: I thought this to myself on the way to the blind date.

text: 回家的路上骂了自己一路真tm没出息，也觉着自己这人也太肤浅了。
en: On the way home I cursed myself the whole way for being really f***ing useless, and also felt I was far too shallow.

text: 但怎么也想不明白照片和真人为什么差距会那么大。
en: But no matter how I turned it over, I could not understand why the gap between the photos and the real person was so vast.

text: 都是为了公主好。
en: It is all for the princess's own good.

text: 40岁才生小孩，很危险的。
en: Having a child only at 40 is very dangerous.

text: 40岁不生小孩，那何必带个40岁秃头大叔生活呢？
en: If you don't have a child at 40, then why live with a 40-year-old balding old man?

text: 我们只有发冠，没有皇冠。
en: We only have a hair crown, not a royal crown.

text: 40岁，是一个非常尴尬的年纪，女性再过10年-15年可能就绝经了，男性还在需求旺盛期，这个矛盾无法兼容啊。
en: 40 is a very awkward age: women may reach menopause in another 10 to 15 years, while men are still at the peak of their sexual drive, and this contradiction simply cannot be reconciled.

text: 总不能到时候都是女性在单方面付出吧。
en: Surely it cannot come to pass that by then all the giving is one-sided on the part of women.

text: 40岁女，无非几种可能：
en: A 40-year-old woman—there are only a few possibilities:

text: 一种是结过婚，离了，带孩子，一个或两个，都是非常麻烦的，很少有人会做到课题分离，都会把本该自己处理的事加到另一半身上，熵非常大，生活极不容易。
en: One is someone who was married, divorced, and has children—one or two—which is very troublesome; very few people manage task separation, and they all pile onto their partner things that ought to be handled by themselves, creating enormous entropy, and life becomes extremely difficult.

text: 第二种是离了，没有生育，这种相对好一些，但毕竟结过，当初所有的仪式感都体验过了，所有的誓言都听过了，最后还是离开了，年纪也大了，也不容易再爱了。
en: The second is someone divorced with no children; this is relatively better, but after all she has been married, has experienced all the sense of ritual, heard all the vows, and in the end still left; she is older now and it is not easy to love again.

text: 但好处在于还未生育过，所以有生育欲望，双方有共同的孩子这种情况下感情会相对稳定一些，也更会为对方考虑一些。
en: But the advantage is that she has not yet given birth, so she still has the desire to bear children; if both sides have a child together, the relationship will be relatively more stable, and each will consider the other rather more.

text: 第三种是离了，有生育，孩子没在身边。
en: The third is divorced with children, but the children are not around.

text: 这种还不如第二种呢。
en: This is even worse than the second type.

text: 第一种与第三种，只要有生育过，就会存在很大概率不想再生育，这种情况下，二婚的稳固性不高。
en: For the first and third types, as long as they have given birth before, there is a high probability they will not want to have children again; under these circumstances, the stability of a second marriage is not high.

text: 第四种是一直单身到40岁，这种或多或少会有一些缺陷，比如曾经的一些经历，身体原因，性格原因，家庭原因，种种，但仍是40岁中最优秀的对象了。
en: The fourth is someone who has remained single until 40; such a person will more or less have some flaws—such as past experiences, physical reasons, personality reasons, family reasons, and so on—but is still the best prospect among 40-year-olds.

text: 第五种是现在单身的40岁，曾经谈过几场恋爱，甚至同居过，再甚堕胎过，反正也是很复杂的。
en: The fifth is a currently single 40-year-old who has had a few relationships, even cohabited, and even had an abortion; in any case it is also very complicated.

text: 综上，岁数大意味着大概率熵很大，这就不是其他人能轻易HOLD住的，所以要谨慎再谨慎。
en: In summary, being older means a high probability of great entropy, which is not something others can easily HOLD; therefore one must be cautious, and cautious again.

text: one more thing，40岁的男人无论是离异还是未婚，情感上相对来说男人更纯粹，更可能是为了爱情，哪怕只是为了多巴胺，也是很纯粹的。
en: one more thing, whether a 40-year-old man is divorced or unmarried, emotionally men are relatively purer; they are more likely to be after love, and even if only for dopamine, it is still very pure.

text: 更何况，对比心若磐石的40岁女，20多岁的小姑娘更可能被感动被拿下，更可能持续走到最后。
en: Moreover, compared with a 40-year-old woman whose heart is like bedrock, a girl in her twenties is more likely to be moved and won over, and more likely to go all the way to the end.

text: 综上，只要稍有条件，40岁男普遍不会考虑同岁的女人。
en: In summary, as long as they have even modest means, 40-year-old men generally will not consider women of the same age.

text: 基本都往年轻的考虑去了。
en: They basically all lean towards considering younger ones.

text: 我刚才还看到一个女孩说妈妈二婚想二胎，因为妈妈47岁数大了，妈妈男朋友39，头婚没孩子，她不想妈妈二胎危险，也不想分享母爱…
en: Just now I also saw a girl say her mother wants a second child in her second marriage, because her mother is 47 and getting on in years, her mother's boyfriend is 39, in his first marriage with no children, and she does not want her mother to risk a second pregnancy, nor does she want to share her mother's love…

text: 其实男的条件好，82找28的，条件不好有女人都不错了…
en: Actually, if a man's conditions are good, an '82 with a '28; if his conditions are poor, having any woman at all is already good fortune…

text: 主要点是条件而不是年龄。
en: The main point is conditions, not age.

text: 这个问题可以换一种问法，为什么月薪3000的女的看不上月薪3000的男的？
en: This question can be phrased another way: why does a woman earning 3,000 a month look down on a man earning 3,000 a month?

text: 我三十六七岁的时候也经常相亲。
en: When I was thirty-six or seven I also went on blind dates often.

text: 超过35岁来相亲的美女确实有一大把（指7分以上的颜值，我也不知道咋那么多大龄美女）但有什么用，多数都是对父母的话不厌其烦来应付的。
en: There really are a great many beautiful women over 35 who come to blind dates (referring to looks of 7/10 or above—I don't know why there are so many older beauties), but what good is it; the majority are just endlessly humouring their parents to get them off their backs.

text: 我留的印象最深的是一个37岁的美女。
en: The one who left the deepest impression on me was a 37-year-old beauty.

text: 跟我还是一个初中呢，简直就是变态。
en: She was even from the same junior high as me—simply bizarre.

text: 无论你说什么，他都呛着你，每一句都是。
en: No matter what you said, she would talk back at you, every single sentence.

text: 给我恶心坏了。
en: She utterly disgusted me.

text: 后来介绍的人跟我妈说她跟一个前任分手，感情受的刺激很大。
en: Later the matchmaker told my mother that she had broken up with a former partner and been badly hurt emotionally.

text: 就是那句话，如果你收入不太高的话，别太拿自己当回事儿，也别抱太大期望。
en: It comes down to that saying: if your income is not very high, don't think too highly of yourself, and don't harbour too great expectations.

text: 这里面就有一个问题。
en: Herein lies a problem.

text: 如果你没钱找哪个年龄段都费劲，如果你有钱，为什么不找个年轻的？
en: If you have no money, finding anyone of any age group is hard; if you have money, why not find a younger one?

text: 同样40岁，女的显老，男的像30多岁，这个是外貌差异。
en: At the same age of 40, women look older while men look as if in their thirties; this is the difference in appearance.

text: 40岁女的生育风险太大，个别的绝经无法生育，即使能生的，问题也多，40岁以上不建议生孩子。
en: The childbearing risk for 40-year-old women is too great; some have reached menopause and cannot bear children, and even those who can still face many problems—having children above 40 is not advised.

text: 男的普遍喜欢比自己年龄小的女性，只有个别喜欢年龄大的。
en: Men generally like women younger than themselves; only a few like older women.

text: 这么看来我是特例?
en: Seen this way, am I the exception?

text: 2020年10月24日周六晚上, 相亲72年出生, 女儿准备结婚, 小学学历的离异女性.
en: Saturday evening, 24 October 2020, blind date with a divorced woman born in '72, whose daughter is preparing to marry, with only an elementary school education.

text: 对方看不上我.
en: The other party looked down on me.

text: 这两天吃的一个瓜，应该能作为这个题的一个例子。
en: A bit of gossip I came across in the past couple of days should serve as an example for this topic.

text: 说有一个B站大主播，刷视频看到了一个中国传媒大学24级的女学生coser，开展了热烈追求，两个月花了十几万还有各种礼物。
en: It is said there is a major Bilibili streamer who, while scrolling through videos, came across a female student coser of the class of '24 at the Communication University of China, launched a passionate pursuit, and in two months spent over a hundred thousand yuan plus various gifts.

text: 结果还是出轨了，并且在出租房里找到了很多盒计生用品（数量超出常人储配）。
en: In the end she still cheated, and many boxes of contraceptives were found in the rented flat (a quantity exceeding what an ordinary person would stockpile).

text: 一说法是11个，大主播是第三个，另一个说法是称有50个。
en: One account says 11, with the streamer being the third; another account claims there were 50.

text: 并且还找到了 to 主人 这样的签名照片。
en: And signed photos reading 'to 主人' were also found.

text: 之前我身边见过要找年轻的，最大的一个原因就是担心玩的太花。
en: Previously, among people around me who wanted to find younger partners, the biggest reason was the worry that the other party played around too wildly.

text: 结果现在找个24级的（虽然有职业因素），但还是玩的太花。
en: Yet now he found a class-of-'24 (though there is a professional factor), but she still played too wildly.

text: 然后我们大概率能预测到的是。
en: Then what we can predict with high probability is this.

text: 等个二十年，甚至都不用。
en: Wait twenty years, or even not that long.

text: 只需要十年。
en: Only ten years are needed.

text: 互联网上绝大多数人都会忘记这个30-40岁的姑娘以前经历过什么。
en: The vast majority of people on the internet will forget what this 30-to-40-year-old girl once experienced.

text: 她自己身边的人，更是会啥也不知道。
en: Those around her personally will know even less—nothing at all.

text: 我不是说所有人都这样，我只是想说，确实存在一批人喜欢找年轻的女友，原因就是怕经历复杂。
en: I am not saying everyone is like this; I only want to say that there really is a group of people who like to find younger girlfriends, precisely because they fear complicated pasts.

text: 越有钱的越怕。
en: The richer they are, the more they fear it.
